why: `prove` reads /etc/passwd, ~/.ssh and writes OUTSIDE the scratch dir. The sandbox bundle is read-only, home is absent, and writes outside scratch are denied; the attempt must be reported as SANDBOX_VIOLATION, never ignored.
notes: The escape must fail harmlessly; the submission is REJECTED and the attempt recorded. Gate attribution (PROVER_RELIABILITY / BENCHMARK) depends on which stage runs the sandboxed binary.
